title: Discovery and biological evaluation of a small-molecule inhibitor of CRM1 that suppresses the growth of triple-negative breast cancer cells.
authors: Gao, Jiujiao; Chu, Peng; Liu, Caigang; Sun, Zhaolin; Liu, Quentin; Yang, Yongliang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子抑制剂LFS-31与CRM1蛋白的结合及抗肿瘤作用，虽含分子模拟但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Dysregulation of the nuclear export machinery mediated by chromosomal maintenance 1 (CRM1, also known as exportin-1), is closely associated with various human disorders, such as breast cancer. Previously, we identified sulforaphene and its synthetic analogues as covalent inhibitors of CRM1. Herein, we describe the discovery and biological evaluation of another sulforaphene synthetic analogue, LFS-31, as a potential CRM1 inhibitor. In addition, we investigated the reversible binding mechanism of LFS-31 with CRM1 through molecular simulations coupled with bio-layer interferometry (BLI) and found relatively high binding affinity (KD = 43.1 +/- 35.3 nM) between the LFS-31 and CRM1 groups. We found that LFS-31 exhibited a stronger growth suppression of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) cells than non-TNBC cells, and had minimal effect on normal breast cells. Pharmacological treatment of TNBC cells with LFS-31 at nanomolar concentrations led to the nuclear retention of IkBalpha resulting in strong suppression of NF-kappaB transcriptional activity and attenuated cell growth and proliferation, which collectively contributed to the antitumor responses. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to demonstrate the use of a sulforaphene analogue as a potent CRM1 inhibitor that targets the NF-kappaB signaling pathway for the targeted therapy of TNBC.
abstract_zh: 由染色体维持蛋白1（CRM1，又称exportin-1）介导的核输出机制失调，与多种人类疾病（如乳腺癌）密切相关。此前，我们鉴定出萝卜硫素及其合成类似物为CRM1的共价抑制剂。在此，我们描述了另一种萝卜硫素合成类似物LFS-31作为潜在CRM1抑制剂的发现及生物学评价。此外，我们通过分子模拟结合生物层干涉法（BLI）研究了LFS-31与CRM1之间的可逆结合机制，并发现LFS-31与CRM1组之间具有相对较高的结合亲和力（KD = 43.1 +/- 35.3 nM）。我们发现，LFS-31对三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）细胞的生长抑制作用强于非TNBC细胞，且对正常乳腺细胞影响极小。以纳摩尔浓度对TNBC细胞进行LFS-31药理学处理，导致IκBα核滞留，从而强烈抑制NF-κB转录活性，并减弱细胞生长和增殖，这些共同促成了抗肿瘤反应。据我们所知，这是首次研究证明萝卜硫素类似物作为强效CRM1抑制剂，靶向NF-κB信号通路用于TNBC的靶向治疗。
